skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: A full-stack toolkit for taking product ideas from early decisions to reliable production software.

content.text: I am a Full-Stack Product Engineer and hands-on Tech Lead from Guatemala with four years of professional experience. I turn complex business needs into clear, reliable software products and stay involved from product decisions and architecture through implementation and production delivery.

I earned my degree in Computer Science and Systems Engineering from the University of San Carlos of Guatemala. Teaching as a university assistant and mentoring other students strengthened the way I communicate technical decisions, share context, and help teams grow.

images.alt: University of San Carlos of Guatemala, Central Campus
University of San Carlos of Guatemala, Faculty of Engineering

content.text: I am from Guatemala City, place of volcanoes, great climate and charming people. Among my passions are science fiction movies, video games of many genres and keeping up to date with the world of technology.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: I build durable software by connecting product thinking, engineering discipline, and the realities of the people using it.

content.description: Built an accessible, customizable <u>ERP platform</u> that helps small and medium-sized businesses <u>manage, grow, and innovate</u> across their operations.
